glappid-bait.name: Glappid Bait
glappid-bait.description:
This bait is composed of exotic materials that are known to attract the elusive Glappid, a fish found only in Plains of Eidolon ocean hotspots during the night.

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth).

glyph-prism.name: Glyph Prism
glyph-prism.description: Launches a magnetic prism to display your chosen Glyph. Only one may be deployed at a time, and charges are consumed on use.

grand-finale.name: Grand Finale
grand-finale.description: Want a more spectacular fireworks display to show your patriotism? Celebrate in style with this single use consumable item.

grustrag-three-beacon.name: Grustrag Three Beacon
grustrag-three-beacon.description: Lures the Grustrag Three out of hiding. One-time use gear item that can only be used in locations where the assassins would normally appear.
